$comment: The engine/product roster (#285). Read by the #284 spec and by the engine-purity seam test (#287). See ../README.md for the rules: verdicts, the closed-roster rule, intent + impurity ledgers, and module granularity.

verdicts.engine: Extractable, brand-free by intent. A future unrelated Sanity project could take it. #287 holds these rows pure: no app imports, no product-model imports, brand facts arrive as parameters. Known leaks are listed per row as impurities and burn down; new ones fail.
verdicts.product-shared: These two brands' content model and components, rendered by both sites.

rows.why: The content model: schemas, queries, generated types, knob declarations, brand facts. The machinery inside it is real but fused — see the fused list; extraction is governed by ADR 0028's trigger, not by this roster.

overrides.why: decorationKnob takes its option tuple as a parameter; no brand values inside.

fused.split: brandConfig()/currentBrand(), the resolvers (resolveDataset/resolveProjectId/readsNeedToken/collectionPrefixes) and the BrandFacts shape are machinery; BRANDS, DEFAULT_BRAND and the FACTS table (project ids, domains, prefixes) are product. One module, no injection seam; BrandFacts is not even exported, so no third party can supply a brand. Import-side-effect-free: nothing resolves a brand or reads process.env until asked, and the knob-entry closure check in the purity suite holds the browser graph out of here.

The roster mechanism (blockArraysFor, sectionBlocksFor, blockArrayMembers, BrandSectionBlockName, the private blockArrays builder) is machinery; CORE_SECTION_BLOCKS, BRAND_SECTION_BLOCKS, BASE_BLOCKS and the authored array addresses are product. The functions close over the constants and the types derive from the values, so neither half exists without the other today.
getClient is machinery; clientConfig is computed from brand facts at module load.
The parsing and dimension helpers are pure machinery; the module-scope builder and rawImageUrl bind to the brand-resolved clientConfig.
schemaTypesWith is a clean brand-free builder; it shares a module with thirty concrete schema imports, so the assembly function cannot be reached without the content.

fused.split: defineBlockRender/bindingsToRecord usage and the AppFirstBaseName subtraction are machinery; the six concrete base bindings are product. defineCardRender, the CardTypeName union and getCard's override lookup are machinery; the three cards SHARED_CARDS binds are product. An app re-points a card type through the cardComponents slot the three card-drawing sections carry, which is how o3xo binds its own case-study card.

The read-the-default-off-the-knobs derivation is machinery; its parameter and return types are the concrete PageSection and Surface unions.
